verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's README lists a dedicated capability to "Discover all URLs on a website instantly." It appears separately from the full-site crawl feature ("Crawl an entire website and get content from all pages"), which suggests URL discovery is offered without a full content crawl. missing for 10: in-depth docs for the URL-discovery endpoint (parameters, limits, sitemap handling, completeness), explicit confirmation that it avoids crawling page content, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instantly discover all URLs on a website without fully crawling it
